name: RA_BILL_PLAN_LINES_ALL
description: RA_BILL_PLAN_LINES_ALL contains the changes to a recurring bill plan, including amount to credit, quantity to credit, override amount, override quantity, and effective date.

columns.name: BILL_PLAN_LINE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the recurring bill plan line.

columns.name: BILL_PLAN_ID
columns.description: Identifier for the recurring bill plan.

columns.name: LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Transaction line number.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the inventory item on the transaction line.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of a bill plan line.

columns.name: MEMO_LINE_SEQ_ID
columns.description: Memo line sequence identifier.

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.description: Unit of measure code.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.description: Total quantity of an item on the sales order line.

columns.name: UNIT_SELLING_PRICE
columns.description: Unit selling price on the sales order line.

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Total amount of an item on the sales order line.

columns.name: WAREHOUSE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the HR_ORGANIZATIONS table. The warehouse identifies the ship-from location and can be used to control taxation.

columns.name: TAX_CODE
columns.description: Tax rate code on the transaction line. Required if LINE_TYPE is TAX. Do not use if LINE_TYPE is CHARGES or FREIGHT.

columns.name: TRX_BUSINESS_CATEGORY
columns.description: Transaction Business Category Fiscal Classification: attribute used in tax determination that classifies the type of business transaction.

columns.name: INTENDED_USE_CLASSIF_ID
columns.description: Product Intended Use Fiscal Classification: attribute used in tax determination when the intended use of the product is a factor either for tax or the tax recovery rate.

columns.name: PRODUCT_FISC_CLASSIFICATION
columns.description: Product Fiscal Classification: attribute used in tax determination for products that have a tax requirement for tax or tax reporting purposes.

columns.name: PRODUCT_CATEGORY
columns.description: Product Category Fiscal Classification: attribute used in tax determination for non-inventory products that have a tax requirement for tax or tax reporting purposes.

columns.name: PRODUCT_TYPE
columns.description: Attribute used in tax determination that identifies the type of product. Valid values are Goods and Services.

columns.name: USER_DEFINED_FISC_CLASS
columns.description: User Defined Fiscal Classification: Attribute used in tax determination to classify any tax requirement that cannot be defined using the existing fiscal classification types.

columns.name: ASSESSABLE_VALUE
columns.description:
Attribute used in tax determination that associates a special value with the
transaction item to use as the taxable base amount.

columns.name: TAX_INVOICE_NUMBER
columns.description: Number on Fiscal document generated during shipment of goods.

columns.name: TAX_INVOICE_DATE
columns.description: Creation date of the fiscal document, generated during the shipment of goods.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER
columns.description: Sales order associated to the bill plan line.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_LINE
columns.description: Sales order line associated with the bill plan.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_DATE
columns.description: Date of the sales order associated with the bill plan.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of the sales order associated with the bill plan.

columns.name: SALES_ORDER_REVISION
columns.description: Alphanumeric identifier of the sales order revision associated with the bill plan.

columns.name: TAX_EXEMPT_FLAG
columns.description:
Option that identifies the applicable tax exemption value for the
transaction line. Valid values are Require (no exemption), Exempt, and Standard (conditionally exempt).

columns.name: TAX_EXEMPT_NUMBER
columns.description: Exemption certificate number, used for transaction lines that have the TAX_EXEMPT_FLAG option set to Exempt.

columns.name: TAX_EXEMPT_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Customer exemption reason, used for transaction lines that have the TAX_EXEMPT_FLAG option set to Exempt.

columns.name: AMOUNT_INCLUDES_TAX_FLAG
columns.description: Option that indicates whether the tax amount on the transaction line is inclusive of tax. Valid values are YES, NO, and NULL. NULL indicates that you cannot override the tax inclusive setting.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: PRICE_EFFECTIVE_DATE
columns.description: Date the changed price becomes effective.

columns.name: NEW_PRICE
columns.description: Changed price on a bill plan line.
